review_comments.body:
**Mixed chunks still lose text** If a streamed `delta` contains both `content` and `tool_calls`, `parseChunk` returns only the tool calls. The text never reaches `getStreamOutput`, so Langfuse still records an incomplete response in this case. Return and collect both fields independently, and add a test that sends a mixed chunk through `parseChunk`; the current test supplies text directly. **Knowledge Base Used:** [OpenAI instrumentation](https://app.greptile.com/personal-org-4986/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/langfuse/langfuse-js/-/docs/openai-integration.md)
Prompt To Fix With AI `````markdown This is a comment left during a code review. Path: packages/openai/src/parseOpenAI.ts Line: 222 Comment: **Mixed chunks still lose text** If a streamed `delta` contains both `content` and `tool_calls`, `parseChunk` returns only the tool calls. The text never reaches `getStreamOutput`, so Langfuse still records an incomplete response in this case. Return and collect both fields independently, and add a test that sends a mixed chunk through `parseChunk`; the current test supplies text directly. **Knowledge Base Used:** [OpenAI instrumentation](https://app.greptile.com/personal-org-4986/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/langfuse/langfuse-js/-/docs/openai-integration.md) --- For each issue above, determine whether it is valid and should be fixed. If so, fix it directly. `````

Good catch, fixed in 53ef3a2: `parseChunk` now returns a delta's text next to its tool calls and the stream wrapper keeps it, with a test that sends a mixed chunk through `parseChunk`. Tool calls are also ordered by index now.
